h: Comfyui中的hunyuan为您制作了最简单的本地视频生成工作流程，并说明了要采用哪些模型以及在哪里组装，+使用LoRa（以星期三为例），+最简单的高档慢动作，+超级慢动作。

o.en: Made for you the easiest workflow for local video generation by hunyuan in Comfyui, with descriptions of which models to take and where to assemble, + use LoRa (using Wednesday as an example), + the simplest upscale and slow motion, + super slow motion.
